Ryan transformation — 25 frames

Choreography follows the reference beat for beat; every pixel is Ryan's own artwork, nothing traced or pasted. One straight-front base throughout — the camera never changes and PixelLab never redrew the character per frame. The badge is one locked layer reused byte-for-byte and drawn under the arms; the whole clip shares one canvas and one registration, so no frame is re-centred or cropped on its own.
